Official factory binary boot and physical hardware validation are unverified. Native authored Xtensa SRAM fixtures execute the documented peripheral MMIO.
QSPI validates clock, SDIO0, chip selection and 02/32 framing. D1..D3 electrical routing and TE timing remain unverified.

AXS touch query B5 AB A5 5A 00 00 00 08 00 00 00 reports one contact; coordinate mapping matches the selected example height-minus-raw transform, without a claim of measured calibration. IRQ is a held contact level; periodic pulses/gestures/pressure are absent.
Old CST3530 touch reset GPIO2 is excluded. Unused PIN_BUTTON_2 GPIO21 conflicts with QSPI D2 and is not exposed as a physical button.
SD wiring comes from the same pinned product repository factory pin header; the selected GFX example itself does not exercise SD. Charger/BATFET and battery electrical behavior are not simulated.

limitations: 已实现 BOOT0、AXP2101 有界寄存器子集和 ALDO3 门控的 1-bit 原生 SDMMC/DMA 卡读写；蜂窝、摄像头和模拟电源功能未实现。
AXP2101 subset is registers 0x03 ID, 0x30 ADC enables, 0x90 LDO enables and 0x94 ALDO3 voltage; other registers NACK/return 0xFF. No fabricated USB/battery/status/IRQ/ADC readings.

AXP2101 datasheet rail defaults are EFUSE-programmed, and exact board EFUSE values are unknown. Diagnostic policy starts SD rail unavailable until guest explicitly programs ALDO3 enable plus 3.3V; this is not a physical reset-default claim. Other voltage values are unsupported.

SDMMC has immediate digital command/data timing and rejects disabled supply/wrong routes. ALDO3 power loss does not yet model the card internal brownout/reset state; do not infer calibrated power-cycle behavior.
SIM7080G AT/cellular/GNSS, camera capture, PMIC power key/whole-board shutdown, charging and analog power behavior are unmodeled.
Factory firmware boot and full application behavior are unverified; no physical hardware validation.

Official factory binary boot and physical hardware validation are unverified. Native authored Xtensa SRAM fixtures execute the documented peripheral MMIO.

The schematic labels U5 XL9535; the pinned SensorLib0.2.3 software names its compatible eight-register digital interface ExtensionIOXL9555. A0 is tied to V3V, A1/A2 to ground, so0x21 is required;0x20 does not ACK. INT is unconnected.

Source/gate RGB is accepted only after routed XL9535 P03/P04/P05 nine-bit serial DCS initialization, resetP06 high, native RGB480x480/16-bit DMA geometry, exact GPIO matrix pins and display awake/on. Vendor FF77 01 00 00 page selection is separate from native DCS.

RGB565 bytes are little-endian at the LCD_CAM callback; physical wiring swaps red/blue and the source MADCTL.BGR=1 swaps them back. Only selected native MADCTL0/8 and COLMOD66 are implemented; alternate bus_rbg_order/V2 permutations, analog gamma and optical calibration are excluded.
AW9364 is a pulse-step backlight, not average PWM. Only its high/on versus low/off endpoint is modeled; brightness steps and timing are unimplemented.

USB-present digital model: expanderP02 is battery self-hold, not a required display supply gate. SD P07 is its DAT3/CS high condition for native mode, not a regulator. Battery/charger/ADC behavior is unmodeled.
CST820 uses source-backed one-point reports and a held-level IRQ. Gestures, pressure, periodic scanning, auto-sleep timing and physical calibration remain unmodeled.
The official file named T-RGB-FULL-3D-2.1-Inches.stp was not assumed to match the75mm Full Circle exterior; the reviewed photo model remains the appropriate mechanical fallback.
